senses.definition: A people, who live on the Kasai River in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
Their language, which belongs to the Bantu family.
Any member of an Akan people of southwestern Ghana and southeast Côte d'Ivoire.
A citizen or resident of New Zealand; a New Zealander
The shell of Olivella nana, used as currency.
senses.example: Marriage with the Bakaya is always by purchase, and the price is 10,000 djimbu.

senses.definition: The ICAO airport code for the Mount Cook Aerodrome.
